entities.name: Zbyněk Stanjura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zbyněk Stanjura is a Czech politician who served as minister of finance in the cabinet of Petr Fiala from 17 December 2021 to 15 December 2025. He was previously appointed to the Cabinet of Petr Nečas on 12 December 2012, serving as minister of transport until July 2013. He was a member of the Chamber of Deputies from 2010 until 2025, representing the Civic Democratic Party (ODS), and previously served as Mayor of Opava from 2002 to 2010.
